cardinality_assertion.gloss: a collection is checked against an exact count
cardinality_assertion.plain: a collection is checked against an exact count

cover_partition_formula.gloss: several collections are checked against a whole universe for complete reach or clean separation
cover_partition_formula.plain: collections are checked for complete reach or clean separation

emergent_register_assignment.gloss: several modes of the same pattern are fused under one result name
emergent_register_assignment.plain: several modes of one pattern fuse into a named result

membership_assertion.gloss: one item is checked for belonging inside an allowed collection
membership_assertion.plain: one item is checked for belonging inside an allowed collection

production_recipe.gloss: a named outcome is built from weighted requirements and possible side results
production_recipe.plain: a named outcome is built from weighted requirements

relation_dependency.gloss: one condition points forward to a later condition that depends on it
relation_dependency.plain: one condition points forward to a later dependent condition

set_operation_formula.gloss: two finite collections are combined or overlapped to form another collection
set_operation_formula.plain: finite collections are combined or overlapped

state_vector.gloss: one profile records several weighted signals at the same time
state_vector.plain: one profile records several weighted activations

typed_program.gloss: a named starting value is saved, a reusable typed action is declared, and that action is then used
typed_program.plain: a named value and typed reusable action are declared and then used

yield_query.gloss: a request asks for the expected actual or efficient amount of a named outcome
yield_query.plain: a request asks for expected actual or efficient amount
